notes: Expedition, Aquapolis and Skyridge (e-Card era) cards are recognised from the dot-code strip and measured with their own rules: the wider left and bottom borders are by design, so centering is read past the e-Reader strips and the fading yellow isn't marked as a stain. Two cards that had no left/right centering before now measure near 50/50.
Phone 0.9.11: the one-page summary on each graded card, and How close the estimates are lists the cards one by one with where each missed.
